site.title: David Parreño - Computer Engineering
site.description: Personal Portfolio of David Parreño, computer engineering graduated from the University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria (ULPGC) who is searching for an opportunity to demonstrate his skills and knowledge in software development.
site.author: David Parreño
site.name: David Parreño

introduction: My name is David, and I have always been passionate about programming. I completed my Computer Engineering degree at the University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria in 2022, and in 2025 I went on to finish my Master’s degree at the University of Limerick.

Over the years, I have gained knowledge and experience in developing software products using programming languages such as Java, C++, C#, JavaScript and Python. The projects I have worked on adhere to Clean Code principles and utilise architectural models such as MVC and design patterns such as Command and Observer.

projects.name: Canarias Flavor Pack
projects.description: Canarias Flavor Pack is a mod for CK3 focused on the historical and cultural representation of the indigenous peoples and their traditions in the Canary Islands. An effort has been made to represent the islands as faithfully as possible, based on historical sources or plausible assumptions.

projects.name: Expedia - Expedient Manager
projects.skills: Teamwork, Git, Test-Driven Development (TDD), Gherkin, Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), Communication, Maven, Bash, Java
projects.description:
Expedia is a desktop application designed for the efficient management of general entry records and expedients processed by the Industry and Commerce Service of the Cabildo de Gran Canaria.

The main objective of this project is to facilitate Service workers to monitor the status and evolution of each of the processed records, optimizing certain repetitive tasks and reducing possible human errors.

projects.name: Design and Implementation of a Generic Lexical Analysis Engine of source code for VPL
projects.skills: PHP, Moodle, GNU/Linux, Behat, PHPUnit, Docker, Git, Visual Studio Code, Sphinx
projects.description:
Lexical analysis engine for VPL that improves the lexical processing with the lexical definition of the programming languages from external JSON files called rules files.

This final degree project greatly facilitates the incorporation of programming languages for the lexical analysis performed in the early phases of the VPL similarity search. Besides, it is an adaptation of the current Ace source code editor tokenizer.
